fields.default: Controls which greenhouses are listed in the New Application Floor Plan dropdown. A greenhouse appears only when its farm is in Allowed Farms AND its name does not match any Exclude Keyword.
fields.label: Note

fields.description: Greenhouses are shown in the spray plan dropdown only when their Farm is listed here. Leaving this empty hides every greenhouse.
fields.label: Allowed Farms

fields.description: Case-insensitive substrings. Any greenhouse whose name contains one of these is hidden (e.g. 'phase', 'tunnel', 'ipm', 'wetland').
fields.label: Exclude Keywords

fields.description: Warn if the same IRAC code was used on the same greenhouse within this many days.
fields.label: IRAC Rotation Window (days)

fields.description: Warn if the same FRAC code was used on the same greenhouse within this many days.
fields.label: FRAC Rotation Window (days)

fields.options:
Pending Submission→Awaiting Approval→Approved→Chemical Issued→Tank Mix Manufactured→Spraying In Progress→Completed

1. CSU Chemical Transfer

Store → CSU warehouse.
No P&L impact — warehouse-to-warehouse Stock Entry.

2. Chemical Mixing (Manufacture)

Cr Raw Chemical account
Dr Tank-Mix account (incl. valuation difference)

3. Chemical Spray (Material Issue)

Cr Tank-Mix account
Dr Spray Expense account
Accounts for steps 2 & 3 are configured in the Stock Accounting section above — leaving an account blank falls back to the relevant warehouse account.

fields.description: When ON, any Spray Plan Creator can submit any draft (not just drafts they own). Farm-scope checks still apply. Intended for testing — leave OFF in production.
fields.label: Bypass owner check on Submit for Approval

fields.description: When ON, the Spray Plan Transfers page also offers a "Submit without biometric" action. Use only when the biometric device is unavailable — the submitting user is recorded. Leave OFF in normal operation.
fields.label: Allow submit without biometric (device-down fallback)

fields.description: When ON, the daily job stops Application Floor Plan work orders that were submitted for approval but left unapproved for more than the window below. Stopping is reversible (un-stop in Desk).
fields.label: Auto-cancel dormant unapproved plans

fields.description: When OFF, only plans created after auto-cancel was first enabled are eligible (the rule applies going forward). When ON, every existing dormant unapproved plan is stopped on the next run too.
fields.label: Apply to historical backlog

fields.description: Days since creation after which an unapproved plan is considered dormant.
fields.label: Dormant window (days)

fields.description: Stamped the first time auto-cancel was enabled; the going-forward cutoff.
fields.label: Auto-cancel activated on

fields.description: How a sprayer confirms each chemical taken from the CSU. 'labels' requires scanning the printed QR label (default). 'tick' lets the sprayer tick to confirm instead — only for farms where label printing is unavailable, as it removes the per-chemical scan check.
fields.label: CSU scan verification method
ERPNext timezone
fields.options: ERPNext's System Settings → Time Zone governs every timestamp this app writes, every notification, and the clock the scheduler evaluates cron against. It is shown on the SCP settings screen, read-only, alongside what the farms' own coordinates suggest it should be.

fields.description: Leave blank to follow ERPNext, which is almost always what you want. A value here changes only how THIS APP renders times — stored timestamps, scheduled reports and notification timing all follow ERPNext, because they must.
fields.label: App display timezone

fields.description: On by default. While locked the app timezone cannot be changed. A changed timezone silently re-times every notification, scheduled report and spray deadline, so it takes a deliberate unlock — and every change is written to the Error Log under 'SCP timezone changed'.
fields.label: Timezone locked

fields.description: On a plan's own spray date, this is the deadline. After it a supervisor can no longer postpone the plan, and the spray can no longer be started. Read in the site's timezone — check Settings → System Settings if the times look wrong.
fields.label: Daily cutoff time

fields.description: A postponement cannot move a spray more than this many days past its original date. Without a bound a plan can be deferred indefinitely, which is indistinguishable from abandoning it.
fields.label: Furthest a plan may be pushed (days)

fields.description: Extra minutes past the cutoff during which a postponement may still be declared, for the supervisor who is standing in the field at 10:01. Set to 0 for a hard deadline. Does NOT extend the window for starting a spray — that stays hard.
fields.label: Grace after cutoff (minutes)

fields.description: When ON, a depleted farm's Spray Plan Creator can request a chemical from another farm and the source farm's creator approves it.
fields.label: Enable chemical loaning

fields.description: A chemical is 'depleted' (and cross-farm availability unlocks) when on-hand drops below this percentage of the captured baseline.
fields.label: Depletion threshold (%)

fields.description: Pending requests with no response auto-expire after this many hours.
fields.label: Request timeout (hours)

fields.description: A black-and-white digest of today's scheduled spray plans and their progress (issued / printed / scanned / sprayed / done), per farm, to the GM, Spray Plan Approvers and Creators for their farms.
fields.label: Send daily Chemical Planning Progress Update

fields.description: Hour of the day (East Africa Time) to send the digest. 18 = 6pm / end of day.
fields.label: Send hour (0-23, EAT)

fields.description: ON: every CSU Chemical Transfer for a spray plan is stamped with the plan's own cost centre (Work Order.custom_cost_center, falling back to the greenhouse resolver) — so the chemical spend attributes to the greenhouse, the same way Chemical Mixing and Chemical Spray already do. OFF: the transfer is left to ERPNext's own chain (Item Default buying cost centre, then the Company default), which attributes everything to the company cost centre and fails outright when that is blank. Unset reads as ON.
fields.label: Stamp the greenhouse cost centre on CSU Chemical Transfers

fields.description: Used as the fallback expense account on auto-Material-Issue rows when the tank-mix Item has no Item Default for the Work Order's company.
fields.label: Default Chemical Expense Account

fields.description: Written as the Difference Account on the auto-generated Manufacture Stock Entry (tank-mix manufacture).
fields.label: Default Chemical Difference Account

fields.description: Overrides the raw-consumption credit on Chemical Mixing. Blank = source warehouse account.
fields.label: Raw Chemical Account (credited on Mixing)

fields.description: Shared account: tank-mix value in on Mixing (incl. valuation difference), out on Spray. Blank = CSU/WIP warehouse account.
fields.label: Tank-Mix / WIP Account (debited on Mixing, credited on Spray)

fields.description: P&L expense debited on Chemical Spray. Blank = default chemical expense account, then item expense account.
fields.label: Spray Expense Account (debited on Spray)

fields.description: Item Groups whose items are chemicals. New items in these groups auto-register as a Chemical.
fields.label: Chemical Item Groups

fields.description: Item Groups whose items are foliars. New items in these groups auto-register as a Foliar.
fields.label: Foliar Item Groups
Tank Mix Item Group
fields.description: Item Group that marks a BOM and its produced Item as a tank mix. Created on migrate if absent.

fields.label: Tank Mix UOM
fields.description: UOM a tank-mix BOM is defined in — one unit is one batch. Created on migrate if absent.

OFF (default): each farm gets its proportional share rounded DOWN to a measurable amount, and whatever will not divide evenly stays in the general store. Simple and easy to check by hand.

ON: the leftover measurable amounts are handed to the farms with the largest fractions, and each farm's unmeasurable shortfall is remembered as a credit added to its next request. Fairer to small farms over several cycles, but the arithmetic is no longer obvious from one allocation.
fields.label: Balance allocations and carry credits forward

fields.description: Users who keep a company-wide general chemical store. They belong to no farm, so they cannot be listed on a Farm.
fields.label: General Store Keepers

fields.description: Scouting-related configuration lives here.
fields.label: Scouting Settings
